items.text: The significance of the factor e-

items.label: text
items.text: The factor e-represents thefraction of collisions that have energy equal to or greater than the e-(60000/8.31 ×298) = 3×10-11

items.label: text
items.text: So,only one collision in3×1011 hassufficient energy toreact.

items.text: ItisoftenassumedthatthefractionofcollisionswithenergyequaltoorgreaterthanEaisthesameas the fraction of molecules with this energy.This is not strictly true,but the difference is insignificant at highenergies,wherethefractionisverysmall.

items.text: It is,therefore,reasonableto drawthe molecular energy distributioncurve,instead of thecollision frequency curve,whendemonstrating the effectof temperatureoncollisionfrequency.(SeeTopic9 (Book 1: IAS).
